test_name: PII Processing and Transparency - PT-2 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Partner-Gateway-146
Primary NIST family: PII Processing and Transparency (PT); evidence focus: PT-2.
Environment: AWS Commercial. Network access uses VPC interface endpoints; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: consent is captured before applicable PII collection and linked to the relevant processing purpose. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
